overview: Moving to the big city to chase your dreams is a classic American story. And every year, thousands of fresh-faced young men and women abandon their small town roots in favor of the uncertainty and chaos of urban life. Dead on Arrival follows naïve newcomers who quickly learn that the city streets are not only teeming with excitement and opportunity, but also riddled with crime and violence. Caught in the hustle of city living, these innocent young adults are set on a dangerous trajectory the moment they set foot in a new city-they are Dead on Arrival - unfortunate victims of their own ambitions and dreams.
title: Dead on Arrival

overview: Seven famous couples stay together in one of the most luxurious villas in the Netherlands. Led by Monica Geuze and Valerio Zeno, they compete with each other, with the ultimate weapon: love! Through exciting and extremely confrontational challenges, they rediscover their own relationship and the relationships of the other couples. Which couple knows each other best? Which couple is the most attuned to each other and can work together the best? Who will be crowned Power Couple 2024?
title: Power Couple

overview: The brilliant cash-out Alexey Voronov goes on the run. Fearing persecution, he decides to plant a "drop" in his place, Yura Afanasyev, a provincial loser who is the spitting image of Voronov himself. However, the perfect plan gets out of control: Voronov gets a bullet in the head, and Afanasyev is saved by Alexey's security, who mistake him for their boss. In a spacious apartment, at meetings, in bed with his girlfriend Alina – now Afanasyev will have to take someone else's place, become a different person and master the skills of a brilliant swindler from scratch, escape from the sights of criminal structures, corrupt officials and security forces. And finally get the luxurious life he always dreamed of.
title: Чужие деньги

overview: The story follows Kai (played by Takuma Usa), a kind-hearted but clumsy man who struggles to get anything right. Burdened with debt, he is kicked out of his home one day. He receives a call from his twin brother Riku, who is abroad on a business trip. Riku offers him a deal: "You can stay at my place, and I'll even pay off all your debts. But in return…" When Kai enters his brother's house, a mysterious man named Chiaki (played by Ryutaro Imai) suddenly barges in, hugs him, and kisses him. It turns out that Chiaki is Riku's lover. Riku then asks Kai to pretend to be him and break up with Chiaki to pay off his debts. Thus begins a tumultuous mistaken identity room-share story.
title: Hitochigai Kara Hajimaru Koi Mo Aru

overview: A tight-knit crew of three reigns over a bustling barrio in Mexico City — until a sudden tragedy breaks their crowns and renders two of them rivals.
title: Los Reyes de Oriente

overview: Evolution of the Black Quarterback follows retired NFL Pro Bowl quarterback Michael Vick as he travels across America to explore the history and impact of Black quarterbacks on and off the field. The series pays homage to the rich history, celebrates the progress, and sets its sights on the future of the QB position.
title: Evolution of the Black Quarterback

overview: Commissioned by the National Radio and Television Administration to commemorate the 80th anniversary of the victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War, this series is penned by acclaimed screenwriters Gao Mantang, Li Li, Ru Sheng, and Li Zhou, with directors Zang Xichuan and Zhao Yang at the helm. Through the lens of ordinary resistance fighters' growth, it reflects the 14-year nationwide struggle following the "September 18 Incident," highlighting the most arduous chapter of the Communist Party-led Northeast Anti-Japanese United Forces and the people's relentless fight against Japanese imperialist invasion.
title: The Long Way Back

overview: Li Chuchu, an illegitimate daughter of the Duke's Mansion, has lived under the harsh suppression of the official wife for over a decade. When fate suddenly turns against her, she unexpectedly discovers that there is a mastermind behind her birth mother's death. She then sets out on a path of vengeance. In the process, she becomes entangled in a web of love, hatred, and obsession with her legitimate half-brother Li Zhen. Bound by restrained affection and deep emotional tension, the two search for truth and justice together…
title: Hidden Love

overview: In the mysterious Forgotten River Inn, fate weaves a tangled love story between the cold-faced constable, Shen Nan, and the enigmatic woman, A Ke. With her unique ability to enter the dreams of the living, A Ke uncovers the secrets of the past, only to realize that her destiny is intertwined with Shen Nan's, bound by a love that transcends lifetimes.
title: Fate's Crossing Nan & Ke

overview: Lan Che, a street girl dedicated to protecting her neighborhood, unexpectedly gets caught up in a murder case and crosses paths with Lou Mingye, the head officer of the Dali Temple. Initially, their vastly different personalities lead to frequent misunderstandings, but as they get to know each other better, they clear up their differences and work together to solve a series of mysterious cases. Throughout this journey, their bond deepens, and they come to recognize each other's true identities, eventually they both falling in love.
title: Dawn Amidst Hidden Clouds

overview: When Jake and Drew's anniversary picnic turns into a massive breakup that accidentally starts a raging wildfire, they are both sentenced to 2,000 hours of community service which they have to serve together. Each week, they join a ragtag group of degenerates that includes lifelong stoner Hagerty, aspiring socialite Trainy, former biker gang member Doug, and their Napoleonic parole officer Dax Wendell to complete degrading assignments. While performing menial tasks like assisting the elderly, picking up trash, and euthanizing dogs, Jake and Drew continue to deal with their breakup and the constant nightmare of doing the worst jobs in the world, for no money, with their ex.
title: Bad Samaritans

overview: Vyacheslav Tretyakov is a superstar of modern Russian cinema. The perfect picture is spoiled only by the devastating reviews of the blogger-film critic Nikita Kislyak. Tretyakov tries to force Kislyak to delete the video and breaks into a public fight. To restore her reputation and avoid trial, the star will have to fulfill the condition of the hated film critic — forgetting about pride and large contracts, play the main role in an unknown provincial theater.
title: Актёрище

overview: Michael explores the capital of the Czech Republic.
title: Prague with Michael Portillo

overview: Set in 1998 before the historic Kargil war, four boys set foot in the prestigious Armed Forces Academy. Cadets is a coming-of-age story about a world where boys become men of honour.
title: Cadets

overview: Graduated students who become adults go on a trip together to find love.
title: Real High School Romance

overview: In the aftermath of Fat Thursday, the body of a girl is found near Bellinzona. The team of officers engaged in the investigation will find themselves investigating crimes rooted in a past full of shadows. Under scrutiny will be not only the crimes that bloodstain the town, but also and above all the human soul, that of a community that believes it has nothing to hide.
title: Alter Ego

overview: From leading ladies to rising ingenues, women under the limelight must juggle friendship and ambition in their tenacious pursuit of art and stardom.
title: Born for the Spotlight

overview: On the day the apocalypse was supposed to happen, Tomás wakes up hungover in the middle of an orgy in a furniture store. Months earlier, he had left his wife Julia and daughter Noa with the news that the world was ending, without looking back. But when the wandering planet that was going to crash the world passes Earth and life goes on, Tomás realizes the extent of his mistake. Now he will try to regain his former life and the forgiveness of his family, trying to rebuild a world that has not ended, but will never be the same. Meanwhile, Julia, who has always taken things slowly, sees this as a second chance and takes a leap to do all the things she didn't dare to do before. Noa, on the other hand, wonders why the adults insist on destroying the world all by themselves, without the need of a giant planet crashing into the Earth.
title: En Fin

overview: Spain, year 2024. Pilar is a young Princess and future Queen of Spain who, suddenly and hastily, is forced to lead the institution after a scandal involving her father King Alfonso XIV takes him out of the public eye for a few months. Pilar must prove to the country that she is not the irresponsible, insolent, lazy and useless woman that everyone believes her to be. The thing is, they might be right.
title: Su Majestad

overview: Thank God You're Here is a partially improvised comedy, based on the Australian version of the show with the same name. In the show, four guests are placed into a scene they have no knowledge about and have to improvise. The series is hosted by Paul Merton, who also acts as judge and performs his own improvised scene.
title: Thank God You're Here

overview: Valladolid, 1998. Nines is a conservative-minded housewife who is forced to confront everything she thought she knew about herself when her husband falls into a coma, leaving the family video store in her hands. Nines discovers that the business is bankrupt, and she decides to specialize in the only genre that makes them money: porn. Just what she needed, to be surrounded by penises and nipples all day long. It's a good thing she has the help of Chon, the foul-mouthed video store employee, and Agu, a die-hard film buff, to turn "Dorothy" into the city's first adult video store, a place that will end up becoming the epicenter of an earthquake among the neighborhood's residents. Sexual liberation is now unstoppable.
title: Cochinas

overview: Spain, 1997. The inhabitants of Río Blanco, a strawberry-growing village, have accepted that the Moroccan seasonal workers settle in Fuensanta, an abandoned village. But the coexistence generates tensions. Sonia, head of an NGO that helps with integration, knows this. So does Father Ángel, the local priest. And even Safir, the imam. But what none of them imagine is that Fuensanta's foundations hide something capable of unleashing their worst nightmares. The most ancient pain. The most ancestral fear. Regardless of your beliefs... or who you pray to.
title: Dime tu nombre

overview: Comedian, actor, president, war leader - in his own words. The extraordinary life of one of the world's most recognisable leaders, and how war in Ukraine changed everything.
title: The Zelensky Story

overview: The documentary, produced by Gestmusic (Banijay Iberia), will consist of two episodes. The first, 60 minutes long, will explore the changes in the contestants' lives after their time at the Operación Triunfo Academy and follow the rehearsals for this summer's music tour. It will give viewers a unique insight into the emotions behind the scenes during the concerts and the celebrations at each successful tour stop, which has already sold over 150,000 tickets. The second episode will be a special film of the concert, filmed at the WiZink Centre, allowing viewers at home to enjoy the unforgettable experience of this tour.
title: OT23: La gira

overview: Yoon Ju-won is a bright, down-to-earth girl who lives with her single father, Yoon Jeong-jae, when Kim San-ha and Kang Hae-jun, two boys from complicated circumstances, come into her life. Her father takes in the boys to grow up together as a family. Despite being unrelated by blood, Ju-won adores San-ha and Hae-jun and thinks of them as her brothers, no matter how differently others think or say. They reunite after a decade apart - facing new dynamics, unresolved pain and the complexities of adulthood.
title: Family By Choice

overview: "Medina" is a mysterious character who has spent the last 20 years scamming dozens of TV personalities by pretending to be a former colleague with a personal drama. No one has managed to find him yet, but Jorge Ponce sets out to try with this documentary. Is a comedian the right person to hunt down Spain's biggest celebrity swindler, or is there more than one imposter in this series?
title: Medina: El estafador de famosos

overview: The docuseries taps into the incredible story of Father Jesús Silva, known as "el Cura," who created a city and educational project for street children without resources in Benposta, a small neighborhood in the suburbs of Ourense (Galicia) during Franco's dictatorship in Spain in 1956. Silva created a nation of boys, with its own currency and passport, governed by children under the approval of the Francoist government and church. Over time, Benposta became a town steeped in art, education, and enthusiasm, and Silva founded "El Circo de los Muchachos," a fascinating show that took these children without resources around the world impressing audiences with their circus skills, ending up performing at New York's Madison Square Garden.
title: El Circo de los Muchachos

overview: This is the story of an undercover investigator who sacrificed everything and risked her life to show the world the harsh reality she experienced over two years inside an animal testing laboratory. Her investigation, which she eventually named 'The Bunker', is captured in hundreds of hours of hidden camera footage that reveals serious cases of animal abuse. Infiltrated in the Bunker is a thriller that exposes the longest infiltration inside a pharmaceutical laboratory in the world, nd puts into perspective while shedding light on an inescapable social debate: the use of animals in scientific experimentation.
title: Infiltrada en el búnker

overview: The Pasta Queen features Nadia Caterina Munno, descendant of an Italian pasta dynasty, who has racked up millions of followers on TikTok and Instagram. Each episode, audiences will travel through Italy with Nadia, then spend time in her chef's kitchen as she shares essential ingredients from the Italian regions she visited, and makes authentic Italian dishes with love.
title: The Pasta Queen

overview: Antique dealer brothers Henry and Edward set sail down France's most beautiful rivers on the hunt for French treasures to take home and auction off.
title: The Antiques Brothers

overview: Tom Kerridge picks popular items on the menus at modern British pubs and gives them his own twist. He takes inspiration from modern gastropubs to create simple, contemporary, and delicious recipes.
title: Tom Kerridge Secrets of the Pub Kitchen

overview: Sarah is a young autistic woman with an extraordinary ability for lyrical singing. She begins taking lessons with renowned soprano Leonor Delise, but there is tension in the relationship. Sarah will learn to turn her silences into emotions; Leonor will have to restore her faith in humanity and reconcile with her daughter. Music will be the bond that transforms their lives.
title: O Som e a Sílaba

overview: Shrink is a human drama that reaches straight to the hearts of those who are suffering because they cannot resolve their mental troubles, and those who are worried about their family and friends who are facing such anguish.
title: Shrink

overview: Filmed in Los Angeles over a school year, this groundbreaking social experiment features a diverse group of LA teens who open up their lives and phones to offer an intimate glimpse into how social media has reshaped childhood.
title: Social Studies

overview: CBS News will launch a live third hour of CBS Mornings on television and streaming named CBS Mornings Plus, which will debut Monday, Sept. 30 with Tony Dokoupil and Adriana Diaz as co-hosts. CBS MORNINGS PLUS (9:00-10:00 AM, ET) will air weekdays on CBS-owned stations in Los Angeles, Chicago, San Francisco, Detroit and Miami and simulcast on CBS News 24/7, CBS News' national, free streaming news network. CBS Mornings Plus will be produced by the award-winning CBS Mornings team and take viewers deeper into the most important headlines of the day, as well as pop culture, entertainment, health, wellness and financial news. Dokoupil, who will continue as co-host of CBS MORNINGS, and Diaz, will drive in-depth interviews and original reporting on major news stories each day during the new live hour.
title: CBS Mornings Plus

overview: And what if changes to language could bring wider changes to our society? With her acute sense of detail, Athéna Sol invites us to explore the new words shaping a contemporary and more inclusive francophone world.
title: On va dire les termes

overview: Convinced they can find a new home for humanity and save the world from climate doom, three 'scientists' descend to the bottom of the ocean...to Eel City.
title: Descent

overview: In this fresh new travel series Andrew Daddo hits the road with friends to explore what makes Australia "The Lucky Country". Amazing food, incredible events, inspiring characters, hilarious banter and entertaining yarns galore. We showcase the magical spots around our mountains, valleys, rivers, beaches, islands, country towns and the outback. The people, places and picturesque scenery that makes our great country, The Lucky Country.
title: The Lucky Country

overview: The Mandate is a 3 part documentary that will shed new and surprising light on one of most forgotten period in Israel's history - The British Mandate. The 30 years of British rule in Palestine, where in fact, the most decisive in forming the Israeli-Palestinian conflict and the modern Middle-East. The series encounter Jewish, Arab and British scholars, who try, for the first time, understanding and agreeing on the answer to the question - How and why started the 100 years old conflict between Jews and Arabs? The historical narrative is brought through secret documents that were only recently revealed. Rare archive footage from the early 20th century and by using a treasure found, in the shape of hundreds of hours of footage from the 1980's series "Pillar of Fire" that include personal interviews with the people who were personally involved in the historical events of the Mandate.
title: Birth of a Conflict

overview: Stand by for the ultimate classic pop and rock line up! Find out all the different ways you can enjoy Radio 2 in the Park.
title: Radio 2 In the Park

overview: Peter Schmeichel, Freddie Ljungberg and Jaap Stam, three of the Premier League's greatest-ever players, will lead Viaplay Premier Sunday, a new and exclusive live studio format available on Viaplay in six countries. Hosted by UK sports presenter Jules Breach, this superstar line-up will be pitchside for 10 of the biggest matches during the 2024/2025 Premier League season. Fans can look forward to unique perspectives on the latest action from the world's most popular football league, along with views and reactions straight from the top players and managers.
title: Viaplay Premier Sunday

overview: Viewers will embark on a delicious journey across the globe, exploring the rich and diverse world of noodles through the eyes of four masterful chefs. This season celebrates the cultural significance and culinary artistry of noodles, offering a deep dive into both traditional and innovative techniques.
title: Chef's Table: Noodles

overview: The Emmy-nominated series celebrates four culinary giants — Jamie Oliver, José Andrés, Alice Waters and Thomas Keller — who changed how the world eats.
title: Chef's Table: Legends

overview: Out There: Crimes of the Paranormal takes you inside eight true crime cases with shocking encounters with the paranormal world - through eyewitness accounts, expert interviews, and all-new investigations. In each case, amidst an agonizing search for answers, one rumor emerges from the pack: something inhuman is afoot. These in-depth investigations transport us to towns and cities across North America where we speak to individuals with eyewitness accounts and first-person details about the extraordinary, supernatural events that changed their lives forever. A six-year-old boy in the Smoky Mountains disappears forever after being snatched by a mysterious ape-like beast. A UFO crash in Long Island sparks an assassination attempt and illuminates a massive political conspiracy. An occult coven of Satanic witches is implicated in a decades-old New Jersey murder. Lonely ghosts in San Francisco's Chinatown threaten to steal the lives of the unmarried. In these stories and more, "Out There" tracks down fresh leads and uncovers new evidence amid a labyrinth of twists and turns. At the end of the road, the investigations unearth new truths – about the power of mythology, the allure of the paranormal, and the monsters among us.
title: Out There: Crimes of the Paranormal

overview: Celebrations with Lacey Chabert will follow the beloved Hallmark Channel star, designer and philanthropist as she surprises deserving kids, families and adults who are making a positive impact in their communities by throwing them the celebration of a lifetime.
title: Celebrations with Lacey Chabert

overview: After a successful auction, renowned auctioneer Qi Xuan accidentally damages an ancient painting and faints after touching it. When she wakes up, she finds herself in the unfamiliar Jing Dynasty as Su Wangfei, the wife of War God Duke Su Qianyu. To her surprise, just as she finds a way back to her time, she and her husband swap bodies, complicating her situation even further.
title: Coming For You

overview: Xiang Tingdong, heir to the renowned Tangcheng family, is severely injured in a dispute with his fiancée Cheng Che and falls into a coma. To save the Xiang family, Cheng Che finds Xiang's mysterious younger brother, Ye Ran, and asks him to impersonate Xiang. Together, they uncover and dismantle the drug syndicate Xiang Tingdong was involved with. Will they succeed in completing their mission?
title: Be Your Knight

overview: Within a relatively short period of time, an evolutionarily very young species has conquered planet Earth and fundamentally changed it. Investigates how much man has already shaped his home planet - consciously or unconsciously - and what this means for all the other animals and plants on earth. Can negative trends still be stopped or is the "Anthropocene" the end?
title: Anthropozän - Das Zeitalter des Menschen

overview: LMN presents Living in Secret, a new original series on Tuesday, December 2 at 10pm ET. Four one-hour episodes follow real people who are leading secret double lives and are at a crisis point, knowing they must come clean, stop the destructive behavior and make amends to their loved ones.
title: Living in Secret

overview: Widow's Bay is about a mysteriously cursed New England island and its superstitious citizens, led by a mayor who refuses to believe their warnings.
title: Widow's Bay

overview: Peacock's new true crime docuseries World's Most Notorious Killers follows the chilling stories of five shocking international murder investigations of recent times. Each episode will re-examine a different case from some of the most infamous criminals across the globe, and will feature firsthand accounts from former detectives, family members, lawyers, forensic scientists and journalists all dedicated to bringing these murders to justice.
title: World's Most Notorious Killers

overview: When advice columnist Nelly finds her childhood friend Dahlia's boyfriend dead, she joins detective Hogan to help find the killer. However, as suspicions creep in, Dahlia becomes a prime suspect.
title: Nelly Knows Mysteries

overview: When Jazz Ramsey and her crime detection dog Zeus stumble upon an old crime scene, the K9 trainer, her star pup, and ex-boyfriend and lead detective Nick are thrown into the investigation.
title: Jazz Ramsey: A K-9 Mystery

overview: With Deniz's surprise arrival to the Alaca Family, one of the most deep-rooted families in Cappadocia, the balances within the family will change completely.
title: Güzel Aşklar Diyarı

overview: At the iconic FDNY Ten House, two rookies grapple with their legacies as children of 9/11 first responders while navigating burgeoning feelings toward one another, the firehouse's well-trained yet formidable veterans, and the demands of emergency response in the ever-changing yet always challenging city of New York.
title: Ten House

overview: East of Eden will explore the novel's themes of trauma and repair; love and betrayal; duty and free will. The series will sketch an intimate portrait of the Trask family against the backdrop of huge historical forces.
title: East of Eden

overview: Power Rangers is a children's television series adapted from the Japanese tokusatsu Super Sentai Series. A team of five high school students are selected by Zordon to battle evil. Using martial arts, special weapons, and gigantic robots called "Zords", they protect their city Angel Grove from monsters and witches.
title: Power Rangers

overview: Sunset Beach was a short-running American television soap opera, first broadcast in the United States on NBC on January 6, 1997, and last airing on December 31, 1999. The show followed the loves and lives of the people living in a fictional coastal city named Sunset Beach, on the coast of California. The show was co-produced by NBC and Spelling Television. It aired in over 70 countries around the world. Sunset Beach won two Daytime Emmy Awards and was nominated another 11 times. The show also received 22 nominations for various other awards.
title: Sunset Beach

overview: 30 Tage Lust follows high school sweethearts Freddy and Zeno, both about to turn thirty. A daring experiment puts a long-term relationship to the test: Freddy and Zeno agree to 30 days of sex with whomever they want. Throughout the experiment, awkward dates and bizarre encounters create suspicion between them, while moments of tenderness emerge amidst the emotional rollercoaster. As day 30 + 1 approaches, the question remains: Has the experiment brought them closer, or has it been too much to ask? The melancomedy offers a highly relatable exploration of navigating life when you're almost thirty and the journey of self-discovery still proves elusive.
title: 30 Tage Lust

overview: Paula McIntyre travels to the United States on a food adventure, to look at the influence of the Ulster-Scots on America's table. Over time, they became known as the Scots-Irish and their foodways and the ingredients they brought with them have become an integral part of American cuisine.
title: Paula McIntyre's Hamely Kitchen USA

overview: Paid In Full: The Battle for Black Music explores the systemic racism faced by Black artists in the music industry from its inception to the digital streaming age. Despite remarkable success stories, prejudicial practices persist in the machinery of the music industry, with exploitative contracts and copyright arrangements often hindering artists' autonomy and financial reward and coming with a devastating personal cost. Paid In Full: The Battle for Black Music documents the extent of the historic injustice suffered by the music industry's Black artists, including the disparity of profits received by them, despite having created the records that have driven the fabric and culture of popular music - from jazz and rock and roll to soul and rap.
title: Paid in Full: The Battle for Black Music

overview: Leo Ajkic meets some of those serving an indefinite prison term. Those who are not released back into society until they have changed. But can they be changed?
title: Leo og de farlige

overview: In the paradisical setting of Angra dos Reis, two women have their destinies intertwined in a game of love, power and obsession, which changes the trajectory of their lives forever.
title: Mania de Você

overview: The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey explores the tragic unsolved murder of six-year-old beauty queen JonBenét Ramsey. It follows the Ramsey family, before and after the tragedy as they go through the painful loss of a child while facing intense public scrutiny caused by a media frenzy that caused this case to captivate an entire nation. At the heart of the series, it is the story of Patsy and John Ramsey – exploring the unbreakable partnership of these two complex people – as husband and wife, as mother and father – who had committed themselves and their children to building the narrative of a perfect, privileged life only to have it destroyed one Christmas night in 1996.
title: The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey

overview: Set in present-day suburbia, The ‘Burbs follows a young couple returning to the husband's childhood home. Their world is upended when new neighbors move in next door, bringing old secrets of the cul-de-sac to light, and new deadly threats shatter the illusion of their quiet little neighborhood.
title: The ‘Burbs

overview: A current affairs series in which Kevin Magee breaks stories and investigates the issues behind the headlines. Iniúchadh TG4 will feature political stories, social issues and analysis from all over Ireland.
title: Iniúchadh TG4

overview: Kaboul Kitchen is a French comedy television series broadcast by Canal+. It was created by Marc Victor, Allan Mauduit and Jean-Patrick Benes. The series is based on the true story of Radio France Internationale journalist Marc Victor, who ran a restaurant for French expatriates in Kabul until 2008. The first series premiered on February 15, 2012 on Canal+ and ended on March 5, 2012. It set a ratings record for comedy series in the primetime slot on Canal+. A second series, which will have 12 episodes, has been commissioned.
title: Kaboul Kitchen

overview: Singer Jane DaSilva inherits the family foundation which is a non-profit detective agency that helps people who aren't able to help themselves. Jane's Aunt Sadie and Detective John Cameron act as her mentors as she takes on her first case surrounding a mother's untimely death years before. As Jane investigates a multi-level marketing company that took advantage of her client's fragile mom, she realizes that digging up the past can be dangerous...
title: The Jane Mysteries

overview: Rachael Ray's dream since childhood has been to own a villa in Tuscany. Now that dream is about to become a reality … well, hopefully.
title: Rachael Ray's Italian Dream Home

overview: The new trilogy Love On the Danube promises romance, a picturesque cruise down the Danube River and Strauss waltzes among beautiful sights and sounds.
title: Love on the Danube

overview: Keiko Natori is a housewife in her first year of marriage. Her husband is Shinichi Natori, who is elite and kind. She has her best friend Yuka and her younger sister Shiho Aihara. They all wish for Keiko Natori's happiness. Keiko Natori enjoys her happy life until Keiko Natori begins to suspect that her husband is having an affair. At first, she suspects her best friend Yuka is the one who is having the affair with her husband. She then suspects someone else close to her.
title: May Your Misery Exceed Mine

overview: After being betrayed by An Sheng, Su Lu Xia gets a second chance to start over. With the help of the system, Su Lu Xia changes her destiny by resolving the scandal that An Sheng sets her up with and finds a footing in the entertainment industry alongside her new male lead, Gu Chen.
title: Cui Can Xing Tu

overview: A window into the exciting world of social media sensation and entrepreneur, Elisabeth Rioux, as she leads the international expansion of Hoaka Swimwear while juggling romance, family and motherhood. This is Elisabeth Rioux unfiltered.
title: Elisabeth Rioux: Sans filtres

overview: Adaptation of Anthony Hope's novel in six parts, by James Andrew Hall. The Prisoner of Zenda is the great swashbuckling story of the English gentleman Rudolf Rassendyll and his adventures in Ruritania.
title: The Prisoner of Zenda

overview: Going Live! was a Saturday morning kids magazine show on BBC which took over from Saturday Superstore. Presented by Philip Schofield and Sarah Greene between 1987 and 1993.
title: Going Live!

overview: Amélia Delcourt, 32, is an intrepid police officer, recently integrated into the Crime Department, and fed up with news stories from her mother Babeth, an absolute fan of true crimes. Too eager to prove herself and trusting her instincts as always, she makes a terrible mistake during an operation, ruining months of work trying to uncover Shakespeare, a serial killer who is spreading terror in the north of France.
title: Murder Club

overview: A four-part documentary event that penetrates the neon-hued world of Lisa Frank Inc., a brand that defined girlhood for a generation of Americans only to seemingly disappear overnight. Behind the rainbows and psychedelic illustrations, we unravel a nostalgia-soaked, stranger-than-fiction tale that takes us into the hidden world that has been lurking at the heart of the company for decades.
title: Glitter and Greed: The Lisa Frank Story

overview: From horror visionaries Blumhouse Television, and Cake Boss creators High Noon Entertainment, Killer Cakes is a one-of-a-kind competition show where bakers with terrifying skills attempt to win some of the most frightening challenges ever produced for television. Contestants will work with the best horror special effects artists in Hollywood to unleash their twisted imaginations and create cakes so disgusting, so disturbing, and so realistic, it's the stuff of nightmares.
title: Killer Cakes

overview: Shaio Domínguez, in the 1990s in Colombia, founded the first international modeling agency, through which she discovered the power of beauty. Edgar Trejos, a frontman for mobsters, sees in Shaio and her agency the opportunity to clean up his image and will do everything possible to infiltrate them. An impossible love, beautiful women, many dreams to fulfill, and a situation that spirals out of control.
title: Klass 95: el poder de la belleza

overview: Freelance photographer Mo Xiangbei unexpectedly gets pregnant while her childhood boyfriend, Mu Yinan, is focused on his career. As tensions rise over his frequent absences and an actress's advances, Mo becomes increasingly suspicious. After the loss of her mother and miscarriage, she breaks down and leaves Mu, starting a new life in Dali with a small shop called "Regret Inn," seeking self-redemption.
title: Xiangbei Regret

overview: It tells the story of the female lead, Xia Anle'er, whose family was falsely accused by her fiancé, Xiao Yeting, during her youth, leading to their devastating downfall. After years of preparation to restore her family's honor, she must endure humiliation and disguise herself to approach her enemy. In the process of searching for evidence, she caught the attention of Xiao Muran. The love-hate entanglement among the three resolved through love, and ultimately, they protected each other. Together, they not only cleared their grievances but also let go of hatred, rediscovered themselves, and pursued true love.
title: Fate of Beauty

overview: Junior Eurovision is BACK and this year we have changed things up completely! This year, we're on the road, following the action around the country as hundreds of hopefuls apply for our national auditions in recent weeks where they hope to win the hearts of our judges and be in with a chance to sing in the biggest music competition for young people in the world! From these hundreds of musicians, ten will be chosen to come to the studio and compete for the big prize - the chance to sing for Ireland in the JUNIOR EUROVISION SONG CONTEST in Madrid, Spain later this year. The judges hold the power to change the lives of our young hopefuls forever - among the judges are broadcaster Niamh Ní Chróinín, musician, artist and performer Tadhg Griffin winner of the Radical Spirit Award at Dublin Fringe Festival in 2023. Plus, each week we will be joined by a former legend of Eurovision including 2022's Brooke Scullion, 1993 winner Niamh Kavanagh and queen of the Eurovision Linda Martin! Over six weeks, we follow the journey of our ten hopefuls until just one singer remains - the brand new Irish entry for the Junior Eurovision Song Conest. The journey begins on JUNIOR EUROVISION, Sunday 15th September at 8:30pm on TG4!
title: Junior Eurovision

overview: NFL Monday QB is a weekly sports talk show that discusses in detail the previous weekend's NFL games and breaks down the upcoming Monday night NFL match up. The show's premise is to have retired QB's analyze quarterback play from the day before, with CBS Sports' Phil Simms, Rich Gannon and Steve Beuerlein sitting in as the main analysts each week. Fellow CBS analysts Boomer Esiason, Dan Fouts and Dan Marino will contribute during the season. Adam Schein will host. "We don't want to break down NFL games like everyone else is doing. We really want to have a different angle", Berson said. "These quarterbacks won't be talking about the games from the day before. Rather, they'll discuss the quarterback play from the day before". The show will tape from CBS Sports Network's N.Y. studios. On Monday, all the analysts will be in studio. As the season progresses, some will join the discussion remotely. Berson said he wants the panelists to have fun while providing smart analysis. "These guys have unbelievable chemistry", he said. "This is going to be fun and interactive. You're going to see more fun on this show than traditional shows that are breaking down NFL games".
title: NFL Monday QB

overview: Join us for ‘RTÉ Celebrates Culture Night' – a music and arts extravaganza hosted by Denise Chaila and featuring the RTÉ Concert Orchestra with special guests, culminating in an exciting mix of cutting-edge arts and traditional performance with a contemporary twist. The programme will also feature live performances from Villagers, Joe Chester and Gemma Hayes. A highlight will be a pre-recorded performance of David Gray and Colm Mac an Iomaire on Sceilg Mhichíl.
title: RTÉ Celebrates Culture Night

overview: Susan has left publishing and is living in Crete with her long-time boyfriend, Andreas. But her idyll is disturbed by the shadow of a murder committed at a British country hotel eight years ago. Alan Conway visited the hotel and wrote a novel based on what happened there. Cecily Treherne, the young woman who helps run the hotel, read the book and believed the wrong man had been arrested. Now she has disappeared. Can Susan uncover the secret hidden in the book and find Cecily before it is too late?
title: Moonflower Murders
